== Notes ==
* Damage triggers when an [[interrupt]] is registered on the target. Unconditional interrupt effects will not trigger damage unless the target is also attacking or using a skill with an activation time.
* Damage will still trigger if [[auto attack]]s are interrupted (e.g. by [[Wailing Weapon]], [[Clumsiness]], [[Savage Shot]] or [[Leech Signet]]).

{{bug|A target will still take damage even if an effect prevents interruption.}}
